'''Apsul Hunting Ground''' is a wooded area in [[Vampyrium]], just south of [[Sangvesti]], containing [[venator]]s and [[bloodwood tree]]s. There is a plateau atop which [[Letvek (Hunter)|letvek]] can be hunted, with an Agility shortcut leading to the top.
